Colour

Two tiers. Ramps are raw material; components may only ever touch the semantic aliases below them. That is what makes dark mode — and any future mode — a one-file change.

Status — deliberately unlike the brand accent

Info

Draft saved 2 minutes ago.

The rules. Aliases only — never a raw hex, never a ramp step, in a component. Accent ≤ 8% of a surface and pointing at one thing. Amber at most once per page. Colour is never the only signal: status also reads as text or icon. Body ≥ 4.5:1, UI ≥ 3:1, in both themes.

--accent · --fg-* · --bg-* · --line-* · --success|warning|danger|info-*
